explanation: The four data endpoints described by the supplied OpenAPI document return HTTP 404. This page uses only the full example records embedded in that document: six documented roles, six sectors, three courses, and three role-course mappings. This is an incomplete example dataset, not the advertised complete 39-role / 38-course catalogue.
note: Some example course links reference roles outside the available example records. Their names, requirements and progression have not been invented. Run node scripts/refresh-data.mjs after the source publishes its datasets to replace the examples with a validated full snapshot.
